create_concat_dataset_from_configs: create a concatenated dataset from Hydra DictConfig objects with specified sampling strategy and dataset splits
build_concat_dataset_with_sampling: build a ConcatDataset from a dict of datasets using explicit balanced temperature or weighted sampling ratios
get_dataset_sample_index: get the owning dataset index and internal sample index for a given global sample index in the concatenated dataset
compute_cumulative_sizes: compute cumulative size offsets for a list of datasets weighted by their sample ratios
get_natoms_metadata: get the natoms metadata for one or multiple sample indices across the concatenated dataset
